name: ABOT Interpreter
author: ABOT Development Team
description: Battle Orchestration Toolkit (ABOT) script interpreter for MDiceV2. Provides Lexer, Parser, Bytecode Compiler, and VM for ABOT script execution.

notes.cppCliDependency: This mod requires ABot.CLI.dll (C++/CLI wrapper). If not available, the mod will still load but script execution will be unavailable. Recompile C++ layer (Phase 1.5) when ready.
notes.gracefulDegradation: When C++/CLI wrapper is missing, ABotInterpreter methods will return -1/null gracefully without crashing the application.
